description: This file contains HTML template generation functions for OAuth2 callback pages, including success and error pages, with styling and postMessage communication logic.

classes.name: OAuth2PageOptions
classes.description: Interface defining options for generating OAuth2 response pages.

methods.name: generateOAuth2ResponsePage
methods.description: Creates an HTML string for OAuth2 callback pages with customizable content and auto-close behavior.

methods.name: generateSuccessPage
methods.description: Generates a success HTML page after OAuth2 authorization with credential ID.

methods.name: generateErrorPage
methods.description: Generates an error HTML page for OAuth2 authorization failures with error details.
